paper.title_en: Quasi-two-body decays $B_c^+ \to χ_{c0,c1} [ρ(K^*) \to] ππ(Kπ)$ in the PQCD approach
paper.abstract_en: We study the quasi-two-body decays $B_c^+ \to χ_{c0,c1} [ρ(K^*) \to] π^+π^0(K^0π^+)$ in the perturbative QCD framework at leading order. The $ππ$ and $Kπ$ pairs are produced via the P-wave resonances $ρ(770)$, $ρ(1450)$, $ρ(1700)$, and $K^*(892)$, parametrized by the Gounaris-Sakurai and relativistic Breit-Wigner models. The dominant $ρ(770)$ channels yield $\mathcal{B}(B_c^+ \to χ_{c0} π^+π^0) = 3.24 \times 10^{-3}$ and $\mathcal{B}(B_c^+ \to χ_{c1} π^+π^0) = 4.19 \times 10^{-3}$, with constructive $ρ$ interference contributing $\sim 25\%$ of the total. The $Kπ$ channels are Cabibbo-suppressed to $10^{-6}$. For $χ_{c1}$ modes, $f_L \approx 94\%$ dominates and decreases with increasing resonance mass. The ratio $R_{χ_{c1}/χ_{c0}}^{ππ} \approx 1.30$ contrasts with the two-body result $\sim 4.7$, showing that resonant $ρ$ production dramatically reshapes the relative yields of P-wave charmonia. The ratio $R_{K/π} \approx 2\times10^{-3}$ is consistent across $χ_{c0}$ and $χ_{c1}$.
